notes.title: New Levels - Update Bob Help Them
notes.content:
Hello, Bob helpers!

I am very excited to announce that Bob Help Them is officially going to release for Nintendo Switch! So now we are part of the Nintendo family and you can help Bob on consoles too.

The release is happening on March 11th, so keep updated on the incoming release.

Since we are celebrating the upcoming Switch release, I'm also making an update with 15 completely new levels, reaching a total of 50 levels for you guys to play as well as a 70% discount sale, in case you want to buy this game for any of your friends or let them help Bob too, this is your time to shine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39108891/b06441f5c3ab9f74bcdf5e63ba6b225c31d56407.png[/img]

I'm releasing 2 new achievements about the new levels as well.

These are all I've to share with you guys, we love Bob and hope you guys love the update and help him there too.

Cheers,

Gagonfe.
